description: He thong dieu khien THANG MAY don gian (1 luong, khong tranh chap dong thoi): 'idle_closed' (dung yen, cua dong) -> 'moving_closed' (dang di chuyen, cua VAN dong — dieu kien AN TOAN then chot) -> 'arrived_closed' (da toi tang, cua van dong) -> 'arrived_open' (mo cua cho khach) -> quay ve 'idle_closed'. Vi KHONG co trang thai nao vua co nhan 'moving' vua co nhan 'door_open', mo hinh nay MINH HOA MOT THIET KE AN TOAN (khong co trang thai 'violation' nao duoc gan nhan trong mo hinh — thu AG(!violation) se DUNG mot cach 'hien nhien' vi khong co gi de vi pham; day la co so de SO SANH voi cac mo hinh CO loi thiet ke nhu mutex_two_process.json hay dining_philosophers_deadlock.json).
